**investor-tools-app** p95 request latency exceeded **5 seconds** for 5+ minutes.

Likely causes:
- Slow Postgres query (check Cloud SQL slow query log)
- LLM timeout not firing within budget
- Memory pressure causing GC pauses (check Cloud Run memory metric)

Quick checks:
```
gcloud run services describe investor-tools-app --region=europe-west1
curl https://investor-tools-app-gq4yi3pgoa-ew.a.run.app/health/ready
```
